title: Tanzanite: The Gemstone Found Only in Tanzania
excerpt: Tanzanite is mined only in one small area of Tanzania, near Kilimanjaro. What to know before you buy one.
body:
## What is tanzanite?

Tanzanite is a blue to violet variety of the mineral zoisite. It is mined commercially only in the Merelani Hills, near Arusha and Kilimanjaro.

## Discovery

It became widely known in the late 1960s and was named after Tanzania.

## Colour

Colours range from light lilac to deep blue-violet. Many stones are heat-treated to improve colour.

## Buying tips

- Buy from licensed dealers with certificates.
- Ask about treatment and grading.
- Compare prices.
- Keep the receipt for customs.

## Museums

Arusha has places where you can learn about the history and mining of tanzanite.

## No pressure

You are never obliged to buy anything on a shop visit.
